high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "rajinikanth.army." The post features a list of around 30 titles of movies by Superstar Rajinikanth that have been reused by actors of the current generation. The text at the top of the post reads: "AROUND 30 TITLES OF SUPERSTAR RAJINIKANTH'S MOVIES WERE REUSED BY ACTORS OF THIS GENERATION 😎🔥." The post includes a list of movie titles on both sides of the image: On the left side, the titles are listed in blue text: Billa
